Concatenates a LEARNED per-head sink logit as one extra column of the score matrix — the softmax then normalises over scores ∥ sink and the sink column is dropped afterwards; its share is the “attend to nothing” mass. The sink values are parameters of this op (config-silent, read from the model class).
